name: nginx-triage
description: Triage nginx HTTP errors (5xx / 4xx) by inspecting access.log and error.log
prompt: Focus on /var/log/nginx/access.log and error.log. For 5xx, suspect upstream timeouts; for 502 specifically check the upstream server status. Use `tail` and `grep` first; do not restart nginx without confirming the cause.
examples: 请帮我看下 nginx 报 500 的原因
